parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The code returned in synchronization with the Success parameter. When Success is true, the value is 200

ClientId.description_en: The application ID registered for the service. This parameter is used for OIDC or IDaaS

ClientSecret.description_en: The application secret registered for the service. This parameter is used for OIDC or IDaaS

CookieDomain.description_en: The domain name of the cookie. After authentication, the cookie is sent to the specified domain name to maintain the logon status. This parameter is used for OIDC or IDaaS
CookieDomain.description_zh: Cookie的域名，认证通过后会将Cookie发送到指定的域名，保持登录状态（OIDC/IDaaS使用）

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

IsWhite.description_en:
The authorization blacklist and whitelist mode. Valid values:
true: whitelist mode. Hosts and paths in the whitelist can be accessed without verification, while all other hosts and paths require verification.
false: blacklist mode. Hosts and paths in the blacklist require verification, while all other hosts and paths can be accessed directly
IsWhite.description_zh:
授权黑白名单模式：

true：白名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 不需要校验即可访问，其余都需要校验）
false：黑名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 需要校验，其余可直接访问）

Issuer.description_en:
The issuer used when the authentication type is JWT or OIDC:
JWT: the iss (issuer) claim of the JWT, which represents the issuer.
OIDC: the iss (issuer) claim of the OIDC, which represents the issuer
Issuer.description_zh:
鉴权类型为JWT/OIDC时使用：

JWT：表示JWT claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人。
OIDC：表示OIDC claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人

Jwks.description_en: The JWT public key in JSON format

LoginUrl.description_en: The URL of the user logon page for the IDaaS instance. This parameter is used for IDaaS
LoginUrl.description_zh: IDaaS实例用户登录页地址（IDaaS使用）

RedirectUrl.description_en: The redirect URL after successful authorization. This parameter is used for OIDC or IDaaS and must be consistent with the redirect URL configured in OIDC or IDaaS
RedirectUrl.description_zh: 授权成功后的重定向地址（OIDC/IDaaS使用，需要与OIDC/IDaaS中配置的重定向地址保持一致。）

ScopesList.description_en: The OIDC scopes. This parameter is used for OIDC

items.description_en: The OIDC scopes. This parameter is used for OIDC

Status.description_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。

未启用：false

启用：true

TokenName.description_en: The name of the token parameter to be verified. By default, the token is prefixed with Bearer and placed in the Authorization header. Example: `Authorization: Bearer token`
TokenName.description_zh: 要校验的Token参数信息的名称，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`

TokenNamePrefix.description_en: The prefix of the JWT token

TokenPass.description_en: Specifies whether to pass through the token

TokenPosition.description_en:
The position of the JWT token. Valid values:
HEADER: transmitted through the header.
The token parameter to be verified. By default, the token is prefixed with Bearer and placed in the Authorization header. Example: `Authorization: Bearer token`
TokenPosition.description_zh:
JWT Token类型：

HEADER：通过Header传输

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：Authorization: Bearer token

Type.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:
JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ: custom authentication service
Type.description_zh:
鉴权类型：

JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ（自建的鉴权服务）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：

`true`：请求成功。                                
`false`：请求失败
